items.title: Hex founder Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, Turkish media report
items.summary: Police reportedly seized $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches during a raid on the crypto founder's Istanbul residence.

items.title: BlackRock's Fink names a U.S. recession trigger, sounds alarm over $40 trillion national debt
items.summary: BlackRock's CEO says "a moratorium of some sort" on data center buildouts would put the U.S. in a recession.

items.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
items.summary: Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
items.summary: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

items.title: Bitcoin wilts as Fed rate uncertainty weighs. Kospi plunges 8%
items.summary: Bets on an October Fed rate hike briefly spiked to nearly 50% after Wednesday’s inflation report, but have since cooled.
